description: Verify that the First Reserved field of the IPv4 Multicast Option is 0x00 (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Multicast Option: First Reserved == 0x00.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's First Reserved field == 0x00.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
First Reserved on the wire equals 0x00.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_reserved1 — IPv4 multicast first reserved nonzero
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Pass: IPv4 Multicast Option First Reserved = 0x00 — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
